CA.name: California
CA.details: Up to $7,500 for BEVs, income-tiered. Additional $2,500 for low-income buyers.

CO.name: Colorado
CO.details: $5,000 tax credit for new EVs, $2,500 for PHEVs. No income limit.

CT.name: Connecticut
CT.details: $3,000 for BEVs, additional $1,500 for low/moderate income buyers.

DE.name: Delaware
DE.details: $2,500 for BEVs, $1,000 for PHEVs. First-come, first-served.

MA.name: Massachusetts
MA.details: $3,500 for BEVs, $1,500 for PHEVs. MSRP limit $55K.

NJ.name: New Jersey
NJ.details: $4,000 for BEVs, $2,000 for PHEVs. MSRP limit $55K.

NY.name: New York
NY.details: $2,000 for BEVs, $500-1,000 for PHEVs. MSRP limit $42K (most vehicles).

OR.name: Oregon
OR.details: $2,500 for BEVs (up to $7,500 for low-income). Charge Ahead Program.

PA.name: Pennsylvania
PA.program: PA DEP Alternative Fuel Vehicle Rebate
PA.details: $2,000 for BEVs, $1,000 for PHEVs. Available to individuals and businesses.

VT.name: Vermont
VT.details: $4,000 for BEVs, $2,000 for PHEVs. Income-based incentives up to $5,500.

WA.name: Washington
WA.details: Up to $16,000 sales tax exemption for EVs <$45K. Expired 7/31/2025; may be renewed.

TX.name: Texas
TX.details: Some local utility rebates available (Austin Energy, CPS Energy). No state program.

FL.name: Florida
FL.details: Some local utility rebates (Duke Energy, FPL). No state program.

IL.name: Illinois
IL.details: $4,000 for BEVs, $2,000 for PHEVs. MSRP limit $55K. Income limits apply.

utilityRebates: Many electric utilities offer additional rebates for home charger installation ($250-$1,000)
Examples: PG&E (CA), SCE (CA), Con Edison (NY), Xcel Energy (CO, MN)
Check with your local utility for time-of-use (TOU) rates that lower EV charging costs
notes: Incentives change frequently. Verify current amounts before purchasing.
Some states have waitlists or funding limits (first-come, first-served).
Federal and state incentives can stack for up to $15,000+ total savings.
Consult AFDC (Alternative Fuels Data Center) for the most up-to-date info: https://afdc.energy.gov/laws/state
